Primesurf","datePublished":"2022-11-25T15:24:12+00:00","dateModified":"2025-09-02T10:56:55+00:00","author":{"@id":"https://primesurf.com/author/daniel/","name":"Daniel"},"publisher":{"@id":"https://primesurf.com/#organization"},"description":"DenmarkDenmarkDenmarkKitesurfing in the far northAlready head to the warm south for kitesurfing in autumn? Why not rather take a trip to the wide beaches, big dunes and the stormy North Sea before? In Hvide Sande you can explore the endless expanses of the fjord with us or catch some waves in the North Sea. Denmark has something to offer for every kite level! We drop out of the front door directly into the vastness of the dunes and it's only a stone's throw to the North Sea. Empty spots, a dreamlike scenery, windy days and a familiar, Scandinavian atmosphere will welcome you warmly at our home spot.Wavy North Sea and shallow fjordWhen summer takes a break, we head to the north. About 200 kilometers past the Danish border is Hvide Sande, a local place right between the North Sea and the huge fjord. When the autumn storms arrive in beginning of September, this place offers absolute dream conditions for every level. The huge, shallow fjord is perfect for freestylers and everyone who is ready to learn kitesurfing in Denmark. All wave fans will find their happy place in the North Sea. The water temperature in September is also absolutely suitable for frostbites.Sundowner, Dunes &amp; Soft Ice CreamOnly rarely you will get a break from kitesurfing in Denmark. But when the autumn winds take a rest, there is time to relax and unwind. Whirlpool, pool and sauna can be found directly in our lovely house in the dunes. In Denmark's small town you can go for a stroll, enjoy fresh fish rolls or eat a soft ice cream. In the evening we can climb the dune right behind the house and admire the beautiful Scandinavian sunsets from there.Hvide Sande is a small fishing village and offers time to linger if the wind is not strong enough for kitesurfing. Here you will find some shops with Scandinavian decorative items or many typical delicacies. At the fisherman you can buy fresh fish rolls, in the surf store you can drink a delicious coffee and enjoy a soft ice cream at the ice cream store across the street.Our large and cozy community house is perfectly equipped to recover from the many kite sessions and recharge your batteries for the next day on the water. You can recharge your batteries in the sauna or swim a few lenghts in the pool. Heat up with an appetizer in the jacuzzi and afterwards enjoy our common barbecue evening.In Denmark's beautiful surroundings and the Scandinavian flair, you can let your soul dangle. Bike tours through endless fields and meadows, horseback riding along the deserted beach or long walks through the dunes with a view of the vast North Sea. Behind our house, a small path will take you directly to the sea where you can enjoy nature to the fullest.Right in the next village you will find Lalandia with a large aqua park. In the pools with tropical warm water there are huge water slides and water playgrounds. You will also find a standing wave where you can practice and improve your board skills. If you are looking for relaxation, you can enjoy the outdoor warm water pool or sauna.Your team in DenmarkMarci and his team will spend the time with you in Denmark. You will go kiting together on the fjord and catch some waves in the North Sea!","name":"Denmark - Primesurf","@id":"https://primesurf.com/destinations/denmark/#richSnippet","isPartOf":{"@id":"https://primesurf.com/destinations/denmark/#webpage"},"image":{"@id":"https://primesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Denmark_Primesurf_EricBeck.Co-595.jpg"},"inLanguage":"en-US","mainEntityOfPage":{"@id":"https://primesurf.com/destinations/denmark/#webpage"}}]}</script>

</ul></div></div></aside></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="vc_row row-internal row-container"><div class="row row-child"><div class="wpb_row row-inner"><div class="wpb_column pos-bottom pos-center align_center column_child col-lg-12 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark" ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="icon-box icon-box-bottom  icon-media-image" ><div class="icon-box-icon fa-container" style="width:80px;margin-bottom: 0px;" ><a role="button" href="#info" class="text-default-color custom-link"><img decoding="async" class="" src="https://primesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/icon_scrolldown.gif" width="280" height="252" alt="arrow scroll down"  /></a></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-parent="true" class="vc_row row-container onepage-section" data-label="info" data-name="info" id="row-unique-4"><div class="row single-top-padding double-bottom-padding single-h-padding limit-width row-parent"><div class="wpb_row row-inner"><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_parent col-lg-9 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="vc_custom_heading_wrap "><div class="heading-text el-text bottom-t-top animate_when_almost_visible" ><h2 class="h2" ><span>Kitesurfing in the far north</span></h2></div><div class="clear"></div></div><div class="uncode_text_column text-lead bottom-t-top animate_when_almost_visible" ><p>Already head to the warm south for kitesurfing in autumn? Why not rather take a trip to the wide beaches, big dunes and the stormy North Sea before? In Hvide Sande you can explore the endless expanses of the fjord with us or catch some waves in the North Sea. Denmark has something to offer for every kite level! We drop out of the front door directly into the vastness of the dunes and it&#8217;s only a stone&#8217;s throw to the North Sea. Empty spots, a dreamlike scenery, windy days and a familiar, Scandinavian atmosphere will welcome you warmly at our home spot.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column pos-middle pos-center align_center column_parent col-lg-3 mobile-hidden single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="uncode-single-media  text-center"><div class="single-wrapper" style="max-width: 30%;"><div class="tmb tmb-light  tmb-media-first tmb-media-last tmb-content-overlay tmb-no-bg"><div class="t-inside"><div class="t-entry-visual"><div class="t-entry-visual-tc"><div class="uncode-single-media-wrapper"><img decoding="async" class="adaptive-async wp-image-6385" src="https://primesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Denmark-frontpage.png" width="100" height="100" alt="" data-uniqueid="6385-355768" data-guid="https://primesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Denmark-frontpage.png" data-path="2023/01/Denmark-frontpage.png" data-width="100" data-height="100" data-singlew="0.9" data-singleh="" data-crop="" data-fixed=""></div>

icon-box-top" ><div class="icon-box-icon fa-container" ><span class="text-default-color btn-disable-hover"><i class="fa fa-map-pin fa-2x fa-fw"></i></span></div><div class="icon-box-content"><div class="uncode-single-media  text-left"><div class="single-wrapper" style="max-width: 100%;"><a class="single-media-link" href="https://goo.gl/maps/sVJTbySrnmmWohRu6" target="_blank"><div class="tmb 				</div></div></div></a></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-parent="true" class="vc_row row-container" id="row-unique-6"><div class="row limit-width row-parent"><div class="wpb_row row-inner"><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_parent col-lg-9 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark animate_when_almost_visible bottom-t-top"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="vc_custom_heading_wrap "><div class="heading-text el-text bottom-t-top animate_when_almost_visible" ><h2 class="h2" ><span>Wavy North Sea and shallow fjord</span></h2></div><div class="clear"></div></div><div class="uncode_text_column text-lead bottom-t-top animate_when_almost_visible" ><p>When summer takes a break, we head to the north. About 200 kilometers past the Danish border is Hvide Sande, a local place right between the North Sea and the huge fjord. When the autumn storms arrive in beginning of September, this place offers absolute dream conditions for every level. The huge, shallow fjord is perfect for freestylers and everyone who is ready to learn kitesurfing in Denmark. All wave fans will find their happy place in the North Sea. The water temperature in September is also absolutely suitable for frostbites.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column pos-middle pos-center align_center column_parent col-lg-3 mobile-hidden single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-parent="true" class="vc_row row-container" id="row-unique-7"><div class="row limit-width row-parent"><div class="wpb_row row-inner"><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_parent col-lg-2 mobile-hidden single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ></div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_parent col-lg-8 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark animate_when_almost_visible bottom-t-top"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="un-media-gallery owl-carousel-wrapper">

</div>

</div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_parent col-lg-2 mobile-hidden single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-parent="true" class="vc_row row-container" id="row-unique-8"><div class="row limit-width row-parent"><div class="wpb_row row-inner"><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_parent col-lg-9 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark animate_when_almost_visible bottom-t-top"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="vc_custom_heading_wrap "><div class="heading-text el-text bottom-t-top animate_when_almost_visible" ><h2 class="h2" ><span>Sundowner, Dunes &amp; Soft Ice Cream</span></h2></div><div class="clear"></div></div><div class="uncode_text_column text-lead bottom-t-top animate_when_almost_visible" ><p>Only rarely you will get a break from kitesurfing in Denmark. But when the autumn winds take a rest, there is time to relax and unwind. Whirlpool, pool and sauna can be found directly in our lovely house in the dunes. In Denmark&#8217;s small town you can go for a stroll, enjoy fresh fish rolls or eat a soft ice cream. In the evening we can climb the dune right behind the house and admire the beautiful Scandinavian sunsets from there.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column pos-middle pos-center align_center column_parent col-lg-3 mobile-hidden single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-parent="true" class="vc_row row-container" id="row-unique-9"><div class="row limit-width row-parent"><div class="wpb_row row-inner"><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_parent col-lg-12 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark animate_when_almost_visible bottom-t-top"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="vc_row row-internal row-container"><div class="row unequal col-double-gutter row-child"><div class="wpb_row row-inner"><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_child col-lg-3 col-md-25 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark animate_when_almost_visible bottom-t-top" ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell border-accent-color no-block-padding" style="border-style: solid;" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="icon-box icon-box-top  icon-media-image" ><div class="icon-box-icon fa-container" style="width:50px;" ><span class="text-default-color btn-disable-hover"><img decoding="async" class="" src="https://primesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/hvide-sande.png" width="100" height="100" alt=""  /></span></div><div class="icon-box-content"><div class="icon-box-heading icon-box-fa-1x"><h3 class="h4">Hvide Sande</h3></div><p class="text-lead">Hvide Sande is a small fishing village and offers time to linger if the wind is not strong enough for kitesurfing. Here you will find some shops with Scandinavian decorative items or many typical delicacies. At the fisherman you can buy fresh fish rolls, in the surf store you can drink a delicious coffee and enjoy a soft ice cream at the ice cream store across the street.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_child col-lg-3 col-md-25 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark animate_when_almost_visible bottom-t-top" ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell border-accent-color no-block-padding" style="border-style: solid;" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="icon-box icon-box-top  icon-media-image" ><div class="icon-box-icon fa-container" style="width:50px;" ><span class="text-default-color btn-disable-hover"><img decoding="async" class="" src="https://primesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/entspannenpng.png" width="100" height="100" alt=""  /></span></div><div class="icon-box-content"><div class="icon-box-heading icon-box-fa-1x"><h3 class="h4">Time to relax</h3></div><p class="text-lead">Our large and cozy community house is perfectly equipped to recover from the many kite sessions and recharge your batteries for the next day on the water. You can recharge your batteries in the sauna or swim a few lenghts in the pool. Heat up with an appetizer in the jacuzzi and afterwards enjoy our common barbecue evening.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_child col-lg-3 col-md-25 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark animate_when_almost_visible bottom-t-top" ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell border-accent-color no-block-padding" style="border-style: solid;" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="icon-box icon-box-top  icon-media-image" ><div class="icon-box-icon fa-container" style="width:50px;" ><span class="text-default-color btn-disable-hover"><img decoding="async" class="" src="https://primesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/natur.png" width="100" height="100" alt=""  /></span></div><div class="icon-box-content"><div class="icon-box-heading icon-box-fa-1x"><h3 class="h4">Enjoy nature</h3></div><p class="text-lead">In Denmark's beautiful surroundings and the Scandinavian flair, you can let your soul dangle. Bike tours through endless fields and meadows, horseback riding along the deserted beach or long walks through the dunes with a view of the vast North Sea. Behind our house, a small path will take you directly to the sea where you can enjoy nature to the fullest.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_child col-lg-3 col-md-25 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark animate_when_almost_visible bottom-t-top" ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="icon-box icon-box-top  icon-media-image" ><div class="icon-box-icon fa-container" style="width:50px;" ><span class="text-default-color btn-disable-hover"><img decoding="async" class="" src="https://primesurf.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/lalandia.png" width="100" height="100" alt=""  /></span></div><div class="icon-box-content"><div class="icon-box-heading icon-box-fa-1x"><h3 class="h4">Lalandia</h3></div><p class="text-lead">Right in the next village you will find Lalandia with a large aqua park. In the pools with tropical warm water there are huge water slides and water playgrounds. You will also find a standing wave where you can practice and improve your board skills. If you are looking for relaxation, you can enjoy the outdoor warm water pool or sauna.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-parent="true" class="vc_row limit-width boxed-row row-container" id="row-unique-10"><div class="row row-parent"><div class="wpb_row row-inner"><div class="wpb_column pos-top pos-center align_left column_parent col-lg-12 single-internal-gutter"><div class="uncol style-dark animate_when_almost_visible bottom-t-top"  ><div class="uncoltable"><div class="uncell no-block-padding" ><div class="uncont" ><div class="vc_custom_heading_wrap "><div class="heading-text el-text bottom-t-top animate_when_almost_visible" ><h2 class="h2" ><span>Your team in Denmark</span></h2></div><div class="clear"></div></div><div class="uncode_text_column text-lead" ><p>Marci and his team will spend the time with you in Denmark. You will go kiting together on the fjord and catch some waves in the North Sea!</p>
</div><div class="un-media-gallery owl-carousel-wrapper carousel-overflow-visible">
